additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401704-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003340] Charging issue CRM:00641000976
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well,
As per the reported timestamp, the logs indicate repeated issues with the DC_Contactors MG1-MG2_QA09-10 and QA13-14. The session has been aborted multiple times due to the coil being stuck at ON feedback.
To address this effectively, we recommend planning a site intervention.
Below are the troubleshooting steps to assist during the visit.
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check the Coils:
Supply 24V separately to the coils (QA09-10 and QA13-14).
Observe if they pick up properly.
Evaluate Contactor Condition:
If coils (QA09-10 and QA13-14) do not pick up properly:
The contactors might be faulty.
Repair or replace the faulty contactors.
Inspect Auxiliary Contactors:
If the coils pick up properly:
Inspect the auxiliary contactors.
Ensure they are functioning correctly, as they control the main DC output for charging.
Verify Feedback to PLC:
Check the feedback mechanism that provides the status to the PLC.
Ensure the feedback signals are accurate and correctly interpreted by the PLC.
Kindly carry spare contactors in case replacement is needed during the intervention
8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8 Qty-04
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
